title: Malaysian Chickpea Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy vegan wrap filled with spicy chickpea mixture, served in a crispy malaysian-style wrap.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine chickpea, zesty, onion, garlic, cilantro, and lime juice. Blend until smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in diced cucumber and bell pepper.
Warm the malaysian-style wrap in a pan or microwave for a few seconds.
Spoon the chickpea mixture onto the center of the wrap, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap tightly.
Slice in half and serve immediately.
